sources.snippet: VibeVoice-ASRis a unified speech-to-text model designed to handle 60-minute long-form audioin a single pass, generating structured transcriptions containing Who (Speaker), When (Timestamps), and What (Content), with support for Customized Hotwordsand over 50 languages.
